readout: FANA synthesis rate, normalized to the Tgo-D4K parent (fold)
assay_method: Polymerase kinetic profiling (PKPro). 20 nM polymerase, 1 uM 30-mer DNA template, 100 uM each NTP, 1x ThermoPol buffer, 2x LC Green Plus; denature 95 degC 3 min, extend 55 degC 30 min, fluorescence every 6 s; rate from a linear fit of nucleotides per polymerase vs time; mean of three independent replicates.
remark: No WT row: the readout is already normalized to the Tgo-D4K parent, which is 1.0 by definition. The reference sequence is the engineered Tgo-D4K parent, not native Tgo. Position 659 follows the source data, which carries Y and lists the variant as Y659E; the paper text instead calls it H659E. Q93A is listed twice with values differing by 7e-5, and the mean is used.

protein: Rma cyt c (monoheme c-type cytochrome, native electron carrier; engineered here as a carbene transferase)
readout: Product yield (%), C-B bond formation (carbene B-H insertion); plate-normalized, can exceed 100%
assay_method: Whole-cell biocatalysis, 96-well plate screen, anaerobic. E. cloni BL21(DE3) with pET-22b(+) cytochrome c variant and pEC86; induced 20 uM IPTG / 200 uM ALA, 20 degC, 22 h; cells resuspended in M9-N pH 7.4 with 5 mM NHC-BH3 and 7.5 mM ethyl 2-diazopropanoate, room temperature, 12 h. Chiral HPLC (Daicel IC, 47% i-PrOH/hexanes, 1.4 ml/min) against an authentic-product calibration curve; yields scaled per plate by the mean of 8 MMDTDT reference wells.
remark: Sequence is not from the paper: residues 2-124 are PDB 6CUK chain A (His6 tag 2-7, mature Rma cyt c 8-124 = UniProt B3FQS5 36-152); position 1, absent there, is padded with Met so the published numbering is 1-indexed. 160 wells collapse to 149 variants: 9 were picked more than once and are averaged, though the replicates disagree (worst: MLLSDA 63/108). No WT row: wild type was not screened, and the MMDTDT plate-reference wells are absent from the source tables. Enantiomeric ratio is not included; the NNK control library is excluded, its members having no genotype.

readout: Relative activity (fold) of branching/total activity on amylose, relative to WT RpBE
assay_method: Iodine-staining branching-activity assay. 1.25 mg/mL potato amylose type III (from a 100 g/L DMSO stock) and purified His-tagged enzyme in 50 mM sodium phosphate pH 7.0, incubated 20 min at the enzyme's optimal temperature (60 degC for RpBE); reaction stopped by boiling 15 min and cooled, then 10 uL mixed with 150 uL iodine reagent (0.0127% w/v I2, 0.035% w/v KI) in a 96-well plate, 10 min at room temperature, absorbance read at 660 nm. One unit is the enzyme amount reducing the absorbance by 1% per minute; enzyme dosage adjusted to keep A660 within 0.2-0.8. Mean of three independent replicates.
remark: Sequence is PDB 8ZQA, the authors' own WT RpBE crystal, identical over all 620 residues to UniProt A0A1M6PD84; the pET28a N-terminal His-tag of the assayed construct is not included, as its sequence is not given. 90 source rows give 88: the wild type is printed identically in all three figure sheets and collapses to one row. Two blocks are merged: Supplementary Table 10 (47 Rosetta-designed variants, already fold) and Supplementary Figs 11, 14 and 17 (40 variants in %, divided by their measured WT of 100.73 so the wild type reads exactly 1.0 as those captions declare); the blocks share no variant, so the merge rests entirely on that control. Not included: the twelve-BE activity panel and its thermal profile (a homolog panel with no single wild-type sequence), the enzyme kinetics and product DP profiles (WT and 2 variants), the CD spectra, and all docking and MD energies (not measurements).
